title: Better Crafts
description: A Mod that makes Uncraftable things Craftable!
body:
# ✨ **Better Crafts Datapack**

## 👉 [Click here to explore the Better Crafts website!](https://better-crafts-hub.base44.app/)


## 🧰 **About the Pack**

**Better Crafts** is a lightweight yet powerful **Minecraft datapack** that introduces a wide range of **brand-new crafting recipes** — including items you normally can’t craft at all.

Ever spent hours hunting for rare loot, only to come up empty?
With Better Crafts, **you take control** — craft those hard-to-find items yourself using your **crafting table**.

⚖️ All recipes are carefully designed to feel:

* **Balanced**
* **Fair**
* **True to vanilla survival**

So you still get that classic Minecraft experience… just with **more freedom and less grind**.


## ⚙️ **How to Install**

1. 📥 Download the Better Crafts datapack
2. 📁 Open your Minecraft world folder
3. 📂 Navigate to the **`datapacks`** folder
4. 📦 Drag & drop the datapack (.zip or folder) into it
5. 🔄 Load your world and run `/reload` *(or simply rejoin)*


## 🎮 **Jump In!**

### Craft more. Grind less. Enjoy the game your way.
